item.title: AI Builder / Full-Stack Engineer
item.description:
Meet the YozmaTech

YozmaTech isn’t just another tech company – we’re a global team of go-getters, innovators, and A-players helping startups and product companies scale smarter and faster.
We build dedicated development teams across 10+ countries, creating strong, long-term partnerships based on trust, transparency, and real impact.
Here, every idea counts. We value people who are proactive, open-minded, and ready to grow. If you’re passionate about building meaningful products and want to join a team that feels like family – you’ll feel right at home with us.

Our client is looking for an AI Builder / Full-Stack Engineer to join an early-stage startup with a very small team and a high level of ownership.

The company is building an AI-native product for the janitorial industry that automates the processing of large volumes of complex documentation, including contracts and RFPs. The product analyzes this information and generates accurate, detailed bids, including pricing, equipment selection, and task breakdowns down to the room and space level.

This role is ideal for an engineer who can take an AI capability end-to-end — from designing agents and backend systems to building the product experiences through which users interact with them. You’ll work across AI/LLM engineering, backend systems, data pipelines, and full-stack product development.

Key Requirements:
🔹 Strong commercial experience with AI/LLM engineering and backend development;
🔹 Strong Python engineering skills;
🔹 Hands-on experience building AI agents, LLM workflows, or AI-native systems;
🔹 Experience designing backend services, APIs, data pipelines, and working with databases;
🔹 Ability to work with unstructured data and build systems for processing and analyzing complex information;
🔹 Experience integrating and working with LLM APIs and AI models;
🔹 Comfortable building full-stack product features and modern web UIs;
🔹 Experience with React, Next.js, and/or Node.js;
🔹 Strong understanding of system design, data modeling, debugging, and infrastructure;
🔹 Experience testing AI systems and evaluating the quality of model outputs;
🔹 Ability to take an AI capability from agent/backend logic through to a usable customer experience;
🔹 High level of ownership and ability to independently drive technical work from architecture to production;
🔹 Comfortable working through ambiguous product and technical requirements in a fast-paced startup environment;
🔹 Pragmatic approach to engineering — knowing when to build deeply and when to ship quickly;
🔹 English – Upper-Intermediate or higher.

Will be plus:
🔹 Experience working specifically with contracts, RFPs, or other complex business documentation;
🔹 Experience building UIs for managing or interacting with AI agents;
🔹 Experience with both commercial and open-source AI models;
🔹 Previous experience in the janitorial / cleaning services industry or similar domain;

What you will do:
🔹 Design and deploy agentic AI workflows, agent harnesses, and orchestration systems;
🔹 Develop and maintain the backend for AI agents that process and analyze contracts, RFPs, and other complex documents;
🔹 Build pipelines for large volumes of unstructured data, including OCR and vision-based document and image analysis;
🔹 Integrate AI tools and models, including OpenAI, Google, and open-source models, using Python;
🔹 Build AI agent orchestration using LangChain, Deep Agents, and similar frameworks;
🔹 Build backend services, APIs, data pipelines, and core infrastructure;
🔹 Own data flows across ingestion, transformation, storage, retrieval, evaluation, and application usage;
🔹 Design and maintain databases, including Postgres and MongoDB;
🔹 Build full-stack product experiences around AI capabilities, including agent interfaces, review/approval flows, and AI-assisted workflows;
🔹 Collaborate with frontend development using React, Next.js, and Node.js to integrate AI agents into the product;
🔹 Turn structured and unstructured AI outputs into polished user-facing experiences, documents, and product workflows;
🔹 Build datasets and testing approaches for AI systems and implement evaluation metrics, including LLM-as-a-judge and statistical evaluation;
🔹 Debug model behavior, pipeline failures, data quality issues, frontend/backend integration, and system performance;
🔹 Own complex technical problems end-to-end, from architecture and implementation through production;
🔹 Build reliable, scalable, and secure systems for an AI-native product;

Interview stages:
🔹 HR Interview;
🔹 Technical Interview — 30 min;
🔹 Non-technical / Culture Fit Interview — 60 min;
🔹 Deep Technical Interview — 1 hour;
🔹 Reference Check;
🔹 Offer;

Why Join Us?

At YozmaTech, we’re self-starters who grow together. Every day, we tackle real challenges for real products – and have fun doing it. We work globally, think entrepreneurially, and support each other like family. We invest in your growth and care about your voice. With us, you’ll always know what you’re working on and why it matters.
From day one, you’ll get:
🔹 Direct access to clients and meaningful products;
🔹 Flexibility to work remotely or from our offices;
🔹 A-team colleagues and a zero-bureaucracy culture;
🔹 Opportunities to grow, lead, and make your mark.

After you apply

We’ll keep it respectful, clear, and personal from start to offer.
You’ll always know what project you’re joining – and how you can grow with us.

Everyone’s welcome

Diversity makes us better. We create a space where you can thrive as you are.

Ready to build something meaningful?

Let’s talk. Your next big adventure might just start here.

item.title: Fullstack Team Leader
item.description:
Playtech‘s Marketplace and Engagement Games Product Team is looking for an experienced Fullstack Team Leader with strong full-stack web development background, excellent communication skills, and a proven ability to lead teams and deliver reliable, maintainable, customer-facing software.

 

Team Leader will lead the engineering team responsible for two established Playtech products: Marketplace, a casino content management product, and Engagement Games, a real-time gaming campaigns product.

 

The role combines engineering leadership, people management, and hands-on technical understanding. The Team Lead will guide the team in delivering high-quality full-stack solutions, support technical decision-making, improve engineering practices, and ensure effective collaboration with Product, Architecture, QA, DevOps, Delivery Management, and other teams.

 

Your influential mission. You will... 

  • Lead and coordinate the full-stack engineering team.
  • Own day-to-day progress tracking, and risk management.
  • Work closely with Product, Architecture, QA, DevOps, Delivery Management, and external teams.
  • Converting product requirements and business priorities into clear, well-defined technical tasks and structured delivery plans.
  • Participate in solution design, technical discussions, architectural reviews, and implementation planning.
  • Ensure effective engineering practices: code review, testing, documentation, CI/CD, observability, and production readiness.
  • Mentor and coach engineers through feedback, technical guidance, code review, and regular communication.
  • Improve team processes, engineering workflows, release predictability, and overall team efficiency.
  • Contribute hands-on when needed in complex investigations, troubleshooting, or critical delivery situations.

 

Components for success. You...

  • Bring 7+ years of professional software engineering experience, preferably in full-stack web development.
  • Have 2+ years of experience in a leadership role, such as Team Lead, Engineering Lead, Tech Lead, Development Lead, or similar.
  • Demonstrate strong experience with modern JavaScript / TypeScript web applications.
  • Possess solid practical knowledge of React, Redux, ES6+, HTML5, CSS3, Node.js, REST APIs, MongoDB, and Redis.
  • Have experience delivering customer-facing or business-critical web applications.
  • Show a strong understanding of full-stack architecture, performance, testing, CI/CD, and production support.
  • Have experience working with highly available, performance-sensitive, distributed, or event-driven systems.
  • Are experienced in Agile environments and collaborating with cross-functional and distributed teams.
  • Demonstrate strong ownership, accountability, and an engineering leadership mindset.
  • Are able to lead people, delivery, and technical discussions effectively.
  • Apply good technical judgment and guide teams toward simple, maintainable solutions.
  • Communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Show strong planning, prioritization, dependency management, and risk communication skills.
  • Have the ability to mentor engineers and support their professional growth.
  • Take a pragmatic approach to balancing delivery timelines, quality, and long-term product health.
  • Pay high attention to detail and bring a collaborative, constructive approach to feedback and conflict resolution.

 

You'll get extra points for...

  • Experience improving engineering processes, delivery metrics, release predictability, or team performance.
  • Experience with frontend architecture, reusable component libraries, design systems, or micro-frontends.
  • Experience in gaming, gambling, casino platforms, campaign management, or real-time engagement products.
  • Experience with observability, monitoring, logging, and production incident analysis.

 

Thrive in a culture that values...   

  • Technical excellence and engineering ownership.
  • Initiative-taking and confident decision-making.
  • Strong team environment and the ability work with the most recent market-leading technologies.
  • Initiative-taking and confident approach at the workplace.
  • Global scope and inclusive working environment where you can engage with diverse teams and perspectives.
  • Constant learning and development opportunities and professional growth programs.
  • Active lifestyle and mental well-being, supported through sports classes, master classes, and monthly well-being activities.
  • Medical insurance.
  • Paid vacation days, sick leaves and national holidays.
  • Fully-equipped cosy office space located in the city centre (Gulliver, “Palats Sportu” metro station).

 

MARKETPLACE & ENGAGEMENT GAMES PRODUCT TEAM

Our team is dedicated to two of Playtech's products - Marketplace, a platform for managing casino content, and Engagement games - a promotional tool for creating and monitoring real-time gaming campaigns. Both products are stable and well-established, with Engagement games offering seamless integration and customization for engaging player campaigns. Marketplace simplifies the management of casino content, providing tools to access marketing assets and manage game certificates. We thrive in a friendly and collaborative environment, engaging in full stack development using JavaScript technologies like React, Redux, ES6+, and Node.js. Some of our responsibilities include maintaining client-facing and server-side applications, writing high-quality, scalable code, participating in the software development lifecycle, collaborating with other departments for ensuring smooth deployments, and refining internal processes.

 

Tech stack: React, Redux, ES6+, TypeScript, Node.js, MongoDB, Redis, REST APIs.

 

Playtech is an equal opportunities employer. Our mission is to welcome everyone and create inclusive teams. We celebrate differences and encourage everyone to join us and be themselves at work.

item.title: Senior Full-Stack Engineer
item.description:
What We Offer

  • 100% remote work opportunity and flexitime - choose working hours between 8:00-20:00 Kyiv time.
  • Personal Growth Budget in USD (Travel, Health & Psychotherapy, Sports, Education & Training, Software, Work Equipment).
  • Competitive compensation in USD with regular salary reviews.
  • Paid vacation, holidays, and sick leave.
  • Continuous professional growth through mentorship, feedback, and knowledge sharing.
  • English Speaking Club with a native speaker.
  • Access to AI tools, including coding assistants for engineers and LLM subscriptions for non-technical specialists.
  • Projects with clients across Europe and North America across FinTech, Logistics, Hospitality, E-commerce, Legal, Music, and other industries.
  • Transparent processes, flat management structure, and a supportive team culture.

 

About the Role

  • We are hiring a Senior Full-Stack Engineer to become one of the strongest technical contributors on the team.
  • The single most important thing we’re looking for is experience scaling a SaaS product. We want someone who has already seen what happens as a live platform grows: increasing complexity, technical debt, scaling bottlenecks, evolving data models, unreliable integrations, and engineering decisions that worked at one stage but became expensive at the next.

  • This is a hands-on senior engineering role with strong technical leadership expectations. You will design and write production code, own substantial systems end to end, influence architectural decisions, challenge technical direction when needed, and raise the engineering level of the people around you.

     

Project

  • FinTech SaaS platform built for the restaurant and hospitality industry. Our products handle tip pooling and payouts, payroll, reporting and compliance, labor and operational data, and integrations with the systems hospitality businesses already use. The platform is live, serves thousands of customers and moves millions of dollars.

     

Required Hard Skills

  • Several years operating at Senior Engineer level on a SaaS product that grew significantly while you were there. You have seen a system become meaningfully bigger and understand the problems that tend to arrive next.
  • Strong Python and Django / Django REST Framework experience, or deep experience in a closely comparable backend stack.
  • Strong React and TypeScript experience, with the ability to work effectively across backend and frontend when required.
  • Strong PostgreSQL and data modeling skills. You should be comfortable designing schemas that can evolve as the business grows into new products and safely changing them once they contain production data.
  • Production experience with asynchronous and distributed workloads using Celery or comparable technologies.
  • Strong understanding of API design and third-party integrations, including failure handling, retries, idempotency, data consistency, reconciliation, and situations where the system on the other side is unreliable or outside your control.
  • Strong understanding of software architecture and the ability to make pragmatic architectural decisions inside a large existing codebase rather than only designing systems from scratch.
  • Experience identifying and addressing performance, scalability, reliability, and maintainability problems before they become critical.
  • Strong testing practices and experience safely evolving systems that must remain operational while they are being changed.
  • Production experience with Docker, CI/CD, monitoring, error tracking, and observability. 
  • Strong Linux knowledge. 
  • Sound judgment about technical debt: knowing the difference between an acceptable shortcut and one that will create significant problems later, and being able to improve a system while it remains in production.
  • Everyday experience with using AI agents for work (Claude Code or Codex). Familiar with configuring AI toolset, understanding pros and cons of modern AI.

 

Current Stack

  • Django / DRF, PostgreSQL, Redis, Celery, Docker, Traefik, Datadog, Sentry, Mailgun, GitHub Workflows.
  • Next.js, MUI, TanStack Query, React Hook Form, Zod, Vitest.

 

Nice to Have

  • FinTech or financial systems experience, particularly payments, payouts, ledgers, reconciliation, payroll, banking, audit trails, or other systems where financial correctness matters.
  • Experience with restaurant or hospitality technology, including POS, scheduling, workforce management, payroll, or similar systems.
  • Experience with high-volume or business-critical third-party integrations.
  • Experience improving a system with meaningful legacy code or technical debt while the product remained actively developed.
  • Experience with multi-tenant SaaS architectures.
  • Experience improving engineering practices across a team rather than only within your own work.
  • Experience as a Senior Engineer in a company of roughly 20–200 people, where your role included helping decide what technical work actually mattered.

 

Required Soft Skills

  • Ability to take technical ownership beyond your own tickets and think about the health of the product and engineering system as a whole.
  • Strong engineering judgment and the confidence to challenge technical decisions constructively, including decisions made by Staff Engineers and engineering leadership.
  • Comfort with ambiguity. Problems will not always arrive fully specified, and part of your job is asking the questions that make them clear before code gets written.
  • Ability to explain complex technical trade-offs clearly to engineers, Product, and non-technical stakeholders.
  • A strong teaching mindset. You explain your reasoning, document important decisions, review code seriously, and make the engineers around you better rather than becoming the only person who understands a difficult system.
  • Comfortable taking leadership during difficult technical situations without waiting for someone else to define every step of the solution.
  • Strong written communication and self-direction. The team is distributed across Canada and Europe with limited live overlap, so you need to communicate clearly asynchronously and drive your own work.
  • Fluent English, written and spoken.

 

Key Responsibilities

1. Own substantial systems end to end

  • Take meaningful problems that have been identified but not fully solved and work with Staff Engineers and Product to determine the right technical approach.
  • Own complex initiatives from problem definition through design, implementation, migration, testing, rollout, and production monitoring.
  • Design not only for the expected path, but also for what happens when something goes wrong in production.

  • Remain responsible for the systems you build once they are carrying real customer data and real money.

     

2. Help strengthen the architecture of a growing product

  • Work closely with Staff Engineers and the VP of Engineering on architectural decisions and technical direction.
  • Understand the existing architecture and identify where today’s decisions may create tomorrow’s problems.
  • Identify areas where the platform may struggle as product complexity, integrations, customers, data volume, and transaction volume increase.
  • Challenge architectural decisions constructively when you see a better approach.

  • Help evolve the architecture incrementally through small, safe improvements rather than unnecessary rewrites or over-engineering.

     

3. Protect correctness, reliability, and engineering quality

  • Treat financial correctness as a first-class engineering concern.
  • Design for reconciliation and auditability: how we prove a number is correct, understand how it was produced, and detect discrepancies before customers do.
  • Use Datadog, Sentry, logs, production data, and other signals to identify recurring problems and their root causes.
  • Improve observability, error handling, testing, deployment safety, performance, and operational reliability.

  • Make sure recurring production problems are solved systematically rather than repeatedly patched.

     

4. Own technically difficult areas of the product

  • Lead work involving complex third-party integrations, asynchronous workflows, data synchronization, reconciliation, migrations, and failure recovery.
  • Design systems that behave predictably when external APIs fail, requests are duplicated, jobs execute late, or data arrives in an unexpected state.
  • Work closely with Product to make technical feasibility and engineering constraints visible before implementation begins.

  • Help break large technical initiatives into safe, incremental pieces that can be built, migrated, and released without unnecessarily putting the existing platform at risk.

     

5. Make the case for important technical work

  • Identify technical debt, platform investment, reliability work, and architectural improvements that may not naturally appear on the product roadmap.
  • Distinguish between debt that can safely remain and debt that is materially affecting reliability, engineering speed, or future product development.
  • Make the business and technical case for that work using evidence rather than engineering preference alone.

  • Help sequence improvements so they support product development rather than competing with it unnecessarily.

     

6. Raise the level of the engineering team

  • Be a strong technical reference point for other engineers.
  • Review architecture, designs, and pull requests with a focus on correctness, reasoning, and long-term maintainability.
  • Explain why you would make a decision differently rather than simply leaving a verdict.
  • Mentor engineers through reviews, pairing, technical discussions, and example.
  • Document important knowledge and decisions so understanding stays with the team rather than with one individual.

  • Take leadership when a difficult technical problem crosses multiple areas or engineers.

     

7. Remain hands-on

  • Design and write production code across the backend and frontend.
  • Take direct ownership of technically difficult or risky work when appropriate.
  • Debug difficult production issues and establish their root causes.
  • Read and understand the existing codebase before changing it.

  • Build enough direct knowledge of the platform to ensure your technical decisions are grounded in how the system actually works.

     

Who this position is not for

  • This is not a role for someone whose definition of seniority is simply delivering more complicated tickets. 
  • If you prefer receiving clearly defined tickets and technical solutions and then implementing them, this role will probably be frustrating.
  • It is not a management role. You won’t have direct reports or headcount responsibility. Leadership here comes through technical ownership, judgment, mentoring, reviews, and influence.
  • It is also not a Staff Engineer role. Our Staff Engineers and VP of Engineering set the overall technical direction and architecture. You will help shape that direction, challenge it when needed, and fully own the design and implementation of substantial systems within it.
  • It is not a greenfield role. You will be joining a live platform with thousands of customers and a roadmap that does not pause while technical improvements are made. Much of the work involves understanding existing systems, migrating them safely, and improving them incrementally rather than replacing them.
  • If you naturally ask what happens when the system gets significantly larger, how it fails, how we know the data is correct, and what today’s shortcut will cost us a year from now, you’ll recognize the work.

 

Things You Should Know Before Applying

  • The engineering challenge is no longer simply building features quickly. It is continuing to ship while improving reliability, scalability, architecture, and the technical foundation required for significant year-over-year growth
  • There is technical debt. Part of your job is determining which debt actually matters, making its impact visible, and helping address it without stopping product development.
  • Requirements will sometimes be incomplete. We expect you to help shape the solution rather than wait for perfect specifications.

  • You will be expected to disagree when necessary, propose better approaches, and explain the reasoning behind them.

If you are enthusiastic about building innovative solutions and contributing to a cause that matters, this role could be an excellent fit for you.

item.title: Forward-Deployed AI Engineer (TypeScript, Python)
item.description:
B2B, remote, US Eastern Time clients), 2 calls per week with the team.


About the Role
 

We are looking for a Senior Forward Deployed Engineer who combines strong hands-on engineering, enterprise infrastructure expertise, and executive presence.
 

You will work directly with US-based mid-market and enterprise clients, understand complex business problems, design the technical solution, build and deploy it, integrate it into existing enterprise environments, and remain the trusted technical point of contact.
 

This is not a ticket-based engineering role. You will own the full journey:

Business Problem → Architecture → Build → Integration → Deployment → Client Outcome

 

What You'll Do
 

  • Own client projects end-to-end with minimal handholding
  • Turn ambiguous business problems into technical solutions
  • Design and build production AI agents, applications, automations, integrations, and data pipelines
  • Work with complex enterprise infrastructure, ERP systems, data warehouses, APIs, and cloud environments
  • Make architecture and infrastructure decisions independently
  • Use AI coding tools to build and ship quickly
  • Work directly with client IT teams and senior stakeholders
  • Lead client meetings and clearly explain technical decisions, progress, risks, and next steps

     

What We're Looking For

 

Strong Engineering & Architecture

  • Approximately 7–12+ years of software engineering experience; flexible for exceptional candidates
  • Strong hands-on development experience with TypeScript/JavaScript and Python
  • Experience with technologies such as Next.js, PostgreSQL, Supabase, and APIs
  • Ability to independently design system architecture and ship production software
  • Former CTOs, Tech Leads, architects, founders, and consultants are welcome if they are still hands-on
     

Enterprise Infrastructure

Strong enterprise infrastructure experience is a key requirement.

You should have experience with:

  • AWS, Azure and/or GCP
  • ERP systems and enterprise integrations
  • Data warehouses and data pipelines
  • Microsoft/enterprise environments
  • Authentication, security, and APIs
  • Complex or legacy enterprise systems

You should be able to confidently discuss architecture and infrastructure with a client's IT team. This was explicitly highlighted by the hiring manager as increasingly important.
 

AI-Native Engineering

You should already use tools such as Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, or similar agentic coding tools as part of your normal development workflow.

Production experience with several of the following is expected:

LLM APIs · AI Agents · RAG · Vector Databases · MCP · Agent Frameworks · AI Automations

We care especially about how you work with AI—context, documentation, agents/sub-agents, code review, testing, and QA.

Executive Presence

This is a highly client-facing position.

 

You must have:
 

  • Excellent spoken and written English
  • Strong confidence and executive presence
  • Experience communicating with senior client stakeholders
  • Ability to explain complex technical topics in business language
  • Confidence leading meetings with executives, operations teams, and enterprise IT
  • Ability to become a trusted technical advisor rather than relying on someone else to manage the client relationship
     

The client specifically wants engineers who can independently represent the technical work in senior stakeholder meetings.

 

You're a Strong Fit If
 

You are a hands-on senior engineer who thinks like an architect, operates like an owner, and communicates like a consultant.

You don't wait for detailed specifications. You can understand the business problem, decide what should be built, build it, integrate it into a complex enterprise environment, and confidently present the result to the client.

item.title: Senior Full-Stack Developer (Node.js, React, Vue.js) – AI functionality development for stable e-Commerce SaaS
item.description:
Шукаємо Senior Full-stack Web девелопера/девелоперку (Node.js, React, Vue.js) в стабільну продуктову компанію, яка розробляє декілька продуктів в області Retail, e-commerce, Marketplace, Point-of-Sales. Робота віддалена, напряму на продуктову команду з США. Треба двоє людей, тому подавайтеся на вакансію з другом :)

 

Шукаємо виключно українських девелоперів (в Україні, або Європі). Пропонуємо гнучкі умови, деталі нижче.

 

Обов’язкові вимоги (хард-скіли):

• Досвід створення SaaS-додатків на стеку Node.js + Vue.js (або React) від 5 років.

• Активне щоденне використання AI-інструментів для написання коду (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor або аналогічних).

• Сильні навички debugging, problem-solving та system design.

• Досвід роботи з реляційними базами даних (SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MySQL, або подібні).

• Розмовна англійська (upper-intermediate і вище), доведеться працювати напряму з іноземною командою.

• Досвід з Git, CI/CD, unit tests.

• Досвід роботи по Agile/Scrum.

 

Буде гарно мати:

• Досвід з PHP (частина бекенду старого написана на ньому)

• Досвід створення або впровадження функціоналу на базі ШІ (наприклад, інтеграція з LLM, AI-агенти, воркфлоу на основі промптів).

• Досвід розробки на AWS.

• Розуміння фінансового або рітейл доменів.

• Досвід створення/роботи з Point-of-Sales, e-Commerce, Marketplaces.

 

Бажані софт-скіли:

• Колектив досить сінйорний і хард-воркінг, всі підтримують один одного, дуже ліниві не дуже приживаються. Позитивна лінь в стилі “давайте автоматизуємо це, щоб не робити сто раз” – вітається!

 

Ми пропонуємо:

• Реально сінйорна команда.

• Конкурентну оплату.

• Швидкий і простий процес інтерв’ю, без тестових задач.
